reason: Simplified replacement for HAL_RCC_OscConfig to avoid infinite loops waiting for hardware flags. The original function contains multiple while loops that wait for oscillator ready flags (HSERDY, HSIRDY, LSERDY, LSIRDY, PLLRDY) which will never be set in emulation without real hardware. This replacement removes all hardware-dependent operations and returns HAL_OK to allow the program to continue execution.
